title: of every gate constant published under results/, how many can a reader evaluate from the face that carries it, and what does substituting a neighbouring number cost?

join_rules.candidate: every results/**/*.json, `latest` twins and re-derivation mirrors excluded (a twin is a second carrier of one measurement); a file is parsed only when a byte-level scan finds a key that could hold a tolerance, so text in a value cannot select a face
join_rules.tolerance_leaf: a numeric leaf whose own path token is one of ['tol', 'tolerance', 'rtol', 'atol', 'eps', 'epsilon']; `frac` and its family are pruned and published separately
join_rules.block: the innermost container the constant sits in (dict step or array element); a root-blocked leaf is scoped to the whole face and says so
join_rules.identifier: a string leaf under a naming key in the block, or a string value that is itself an identifier; presence is block-first and a face-level hit is published with tier=face and does not count
join_rules.unit: a string under a unit-named key or a value spelled in the unit vocabulary; a key that merely contains a unit word is NOT a unit
join_rules.magnitude: a finite numeric leaf in the block that is neither tolerance-named nor a stamp; unit equality with the gated quantity cannot be established from the face, and is not claimed
join_rules.scale: a string in the block carrying a math marker, or a scale-named string; a face-level scale-named expression with a math marker is published with tier=face and does not count
join_rules.floor: a floor/switch/clamp-named leaf in the block or on the face; required on no row, because a linear gate has no switch
join_rules.substitution: the log10 spread of the tolerances a reader would compute from each positive block sibling; a bound on the price of not knowing which number is the gated quantity, not a unit-verified cost

manifest.prescan: a byte-level key scan: a file is parsed only when a key holding up to 60 characters contains tol/tolerance/frac/fraction, so text in a value cannot select a face and a panel that publishes no such key costs a read instead of a parse
manifest.manifest_scope: the digest covers the selected set (path and size); the walk covers every candidate file, so a new or removed face moves the count, while an edit that leaves a non-selected face the same size is not detected by the digest -- every selected face is re-parsed by verify

rejected_vocabulary.reason: a fraction is a measurement expressed as a fraction, not a gate constant; counting it would repeat the writer-side error that a name is a measurement

notes: the vocabulary is where the over-count would have entered: `frac` is E316's token and pulls 4367 leaves on 176 faces that are fractions of a sample, not gate constants -- that is 3.9 times the gate count itself, so the token is pruned and every rejected path is published per face

the unit is the element almost nobody prints: it is missing on 1047 of 1108 gates, and 33 of them are readable in place at all -- the faces with a complete row are gate tables written to be read that way, not the faces a reader actually consumes

a face-level identifier or scale is published with tier=face and does not make the gate readable in place: 923 leaves have at least one element that exists only at face level, so the reader would have to guess which row the key belongs to

the substitution span is a bound: the block's numbers may not share a unit, so the spread is what a reader risks, not what the gate costs; only 3 leaves are root-blocked and the nested maximum (19.59 decades) is the same as the overall one, so the widest spreads are not an artefact of scoping to the whole file
122 published gates are exactly zero, which is exact equality: a tolerance of zero is not a tolerance and cannot be met by any numeric comparison
